verdict: Palantir's revenue nearly doubled to $2.3B — and for the first time ever, U.S. businesses paid it more than the U.S. government.

kpis.label: U.S. commercial revenue
kpis.note: +148% YoY — passed U.S. government for the first time

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — the AI Platform (AIP) selling to businesses is the fastest-growing part; U.S. commercial revenue alone was $984M, up 148%.

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for governments and militaries, led by the U.S. ($953M, up 96%) — Palantir's original business, now the smaller half.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling the platform and staffing customer deployments.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platforms — Foundry, Gotham, Apollo and AIP.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day.

takeaways.title: Growth is accelerating, not cooling
takeaways.text: Revenue growth hit 96% — extraordinary at this size — with U.S. revenue up 119% and 212 deals of at least $1M closed in the quarter.

takeaways.title: The 'Rule of 40' score
takeaways.text: Palantir's own scorecard — growth rate plus adjusted operating margin — hit 158%, a level almost no software company reaches; adjusted operating margin was 62%.

takeaways.title: Businesses pass government
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue ($984M) topped U.S. government revenue ($953M) for the first time in the company's history — the customer mix has flipped.

oneTimers: Stock-based pay cost $319M this quarter and sits inside the GAAP expenses; excluding it, 'adjusted' operating income was $1,427M (a 62% margin) versus $1,085M on a GAAP basis (47%).
otherDetail: Interest income of $89M on Palantir's $10.4B cash and Treasury pile, less $26M of other net costs — a net +$63M.
follow100Note: Other income adds $2.73 per $100 of revenue; the rows reconcile to $100 within a cent or two of rounding.
footerNote: Government and Commercial revenue splits are from Palantir's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q; all other figures are from the earnings release. GAAP net income of $1,134M includes $6M belonging to minority partners; $1,128M is attributable to common stockholders.
